issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'εση ζωγρων' (esē zōgrōn) is a corrupted or non-standard form, but in the context of the Synoptic Gospels (Mark 3:17), it refers to 'fishermen' (ἁλιωται). The Vietnamese 'bắt người sống' (catching living people) is a literal mistranslation of the Greek root for 'fishing' (halieus/haliotēs), likely due to a scribal error or misreading in the source text. A reader would believe they are catching people, whereas the Greek refers to their profession as fishermen.
